meta_description:
186K likes, 4,436 comments - kanganaranaut on October 7, 2026: "Himachal’s folk music is so underrated, this is one of my most favourite songs since my childhood ‘Amma puchdi ‘
Its essence is a worried mother who wants to know why her daughter lost her appetite, while the daughter can’t express her love sickness she uses the metaphor of a peacock to complain about her lover.
It’s beautiful just like mountain people discreet, gentle and soothing ♥️
Also what do you think of my Pahadi girl poses ?".
